WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) as college_income
  FROM income
  JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.college
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(income.amount) as total_income
  FROM income
)
SELECT 
  step1.college,
  step1.college_income,
  step1.college_income / step2.total_income as proportion
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.total_income IS NOT NULL
